title: In this world, a moon over your head fills while you sleep
description:
Everyone here wakes up with a little moon over their head. Sleep well and it's full. Lie awake and it's a crescent. Mine has been full for years, and I can't remember the last time I slept a whole night.

My twin brother sleeps more than anyone I know, and his moon keeps getting thinner. Then we shared a cabin on a four-night sleeper train, and somebody started standing in the corridor.

It's made up, a creepy blocky story built with code and Blender.
pin: How full would your moon be this morning?
